title: CellDreamer: World Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Neural Cell Culture Optimization

contributions.purpose: 将 Dreamer 适配到神经细胞培养优化
contributions.mechanism: 观测锚定的灰盒随机循环世界模型+约束感知奖励+任务共享先验,连续动作,KL 平衡与训练期观测扰动
contributions.evaluation: 6 个仿真环境(定性设计;n=3 种子)
contributions.domain: 生物系统优化/模型基 RL
contributions.source_quote: We adapt Dreamer to biologically grounded simulators with uncertainty-aware world models, constraint-aware rewards, and task-shared priors for transfer.

contributions.purpose: 验证世界模型 RL 的样本效率优势
contributions.evaluation: 6 环境上最终奖励与 AUC 均超 Random/PPO(n=3);对 BO 仅在 Env06 一个环境有可比 artifact 且胜出
contributions.source_quote: Across six simulator environments, CellDreamer reliably exceeds Random and model-free PPO on final reward and area under the learning curve (AUC) in all evaluated cases (n=3 seeds). Against BO... a direct comparison on one environment (Env06), where Dreamer outperforms BO.

contributions.purpose: 消融与鲁棒性/迁移分析
contributions.mechanism: 容量与组件消融、AR(1) 观测噪声、1-shot 迁移
contributions.evaluation: 容量越大单调更优;AR(1) 噪声略降但仍胜 PPO/Random;预训练带来一致 1-shot 提升
contributions.source_quote: Adding AR(1) observation noise modestly reduces performance but preserves Dreamer's advantage over PPO and Random. Transfer experiments... show consistent 1-shot improvements from pretraining.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We adapt Dreamer to biologically grounded simulators with uncertainty-aware world models, constraint-aware rewards, and task-shared priors for transfer.

notes: Dreamer 领域适配。作者自认多项红旗:"We do not report statistical significance due to small n and missing per-seed tables"(无统计显著性、n=3);"neurite-length endpoints are proxy simulations and were not experimentally validated here"——全部结果基于 simulated 环境,无湿实验验证。BO 对比仅 6 环境中 1 个(Env06),有 cherry-pick 之嫌。reject。
